name: After § 14
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section VI – European Economic and Social Committee
part_text: 14a. Notes with concern the findings of the European Court of Auditors Special Report 12/2026 on the Union's advisory bodies, which concluded that the Committee met institutional deadlines for delivering opinions in only 71 % of cases; notes further that the Court found that the Committee lacks reporting systems for measuring the impact of its opinions on legislation and that its current indicators focus on visibility and volume rather than impact; stresses that an advisory body spending EUR 165 million annually that cannot systematically demonstrate how its opinions influence Union legislation fails to meet the basic requirements of accountability expected of any institution funded by taxpayers;
